status: PRE-EXPERIMENT; no confirmatory outcome observed or previewed
question: WHEN, WHY, AND WITH WHAT REALIZED CONSEQUENCES does prospective information/development anticipation alter adaptive team decisions?

design.configuration_source: existing canonical CONFIGURATIONS; exact states in frozen Campaign 1 protocol artifact
design.quadrature: unchanged three-node Gauss-Hermite per positive-mass hypothesis
design.tie_breaking: first existing enumerated action within frozen tolerance of maximum

populations.reference_rule: all real Q11 pre-decision states in the frozen factorial, no outcome selection
populations.decision: all Q11-reference nonterminal states, remaining in {3,2}; compare every policy on exactly the same b,S
populations.consequence: for each ab in {10,01,11}, primary decision states with exact Xab != X00
populations.null_controls: Xab == X00; retained/evaluated separately; excluded from conditional consequence estimands
populations.terminal_controls: remaining=1; all policies must collapse; no primary two-reward endpoint
populations.other_policy_states: secondary/exploratory only, not primary population replacements
populations.unconditional_target: uniform seed then uniform one of its 384 eligible reference states
populations.conditional_estimator: ratio of pooled event sums/counts; NOT unweighted average of per-seed conditional ratios

CRN.simulation_stream: Random(simulation_seed), one gauss(0,1) innovation per real decision; aligned across policies/configurations/scenarios
CRN.counterfactual_innovations: epsilon[k],epsilon[k+1] from the SAME seed stream for both branches and every ab

decision_outcomes.action_identity: exact discrete identity; no new action-distance threshold
decision_outcomes.tie_diagnostics: inherited reciprocal regrets and mutual tolerance optimality; retain exact divergences in primary estimates
decision_outcomes.pattern_taxonomy: frozen Gate taxonomy descriptive; not identical to D_coupled

counterfactual.first_actions: frozen actual pi_ab versus frozen actual pi_00
counterfactual.continuation: SAME pi_ab in BOTH branches; remaining-1 at the second real decision
counterfactual.real_transitions: true z fixed; real Gaussian observation, Bayes and enabled MIS-v2 in both branches after each action
counterfactual.endpoint_caveat: when initially remaining=3, second action can anticipate third; third reward excluded; not an unbiased Q_2 estimate or global policy value
counterfactual.null_invariant: same first action + identical innovations => identical branches and zero return
counterfactual.baseline_caveat: record any inherited floating-point difference between immediate-myopic and actual Q00 tolerance selections; override neither

numerical_sign_convention.source: hls.discover_v0.EXACT_TOL inherited unchanged, not optimized from outcomes
numerical_sign_convention.precedence: numerical equality first; signs are disjoint

immediate_opportunity_cost.interpretation: belief-expected production opportunity cost, not realized external investment cost

H1.question: structural information conflict characterizes information-sensitive decisions, not an iff rule
primary: mean D_I_loss difference: D_10=1 minus D_10=0
median D_I_loss difference: D_10=1 minus D_10=0
H1.uncertainty: seed bootstrap for prevalence and mean/median differences
H1.tautology_excluded: A_I to Q10 ranking is algebra, not confirmation

H2.question: is headroom alone insufficient, and which capability/history states characterize development-sensitive decisions?
primary: mean H_S difference: D_01=1 minus D_01=0
H2.structural_strata: scenario/problem position/configuration descriptive, not winner comparisons
H2.contrary_evidence: report strong headroom separation if present; no new geometry scalar
H2.tautology_excluded: A_D to Q01 ranking is not an empirical test

H3.zero_event_interpretation: coupled decisions not confirmed; development/Gate coupled-only behavior did not replicate in confirmatory reference states

H4.central: conditional realized DeltaG estimands for Q10/Q01/Q11, including positive/zero/negative evidence
H4.internal_advantage: DeltaQ_ab=Qab(b,S,Xab)-Qab(b,S,X00); raw, >=0 only up to frozen numerical/tie tolerance
H4.secondary_confirmatory_association: pooled Pearson(DeltaQ,DeltaG) with seed bootstrap; undefined on zero variance

secondary_confirmatory_model.type: unstandardized OLS per ab on D_ab=1
secondary_confirmatory_model.uncertainty: same seed bootstrap, not naive state-level standard errors or p-values
secondary_confirmatory_model.non_estimable: report null on rank deficiency/nonfinite fit; do not drop terms, transform or regularize

bootstrap.cluster_rule: retain ALL rows of each selected seed with multiplicity; shared index matrix across all estimates
bootstrap.undefined_resamples: report counts/fractions; percentiles on defined replicates explicitly conditional on estimability; all undefined => null interval

multiplicity.primary_evidence: effect estimates and uncertainty intervals, not p-value families

exploratory: H1 logistic model if later fitted
prior_observation_provenance: preserve frozen Campaign 1 contamination labels; new seeds are not wholly out-of-sample worlds

falsification_rules.H1: weakened by lack of reproducible relationship between information divergence and frozen pre-decision conflict descriptors
falsification_rules.H2: weakened if no interpretable structural distinction beyond algebraic A_D; strong headroom separation must also be reported
falsification_rules.H3: not confirmed if no coupled decisions recur in seeds 10-49
falsification_rules.H4: prospective usefulness weakened by predominantly non-positive divergent-state realized DeltaG; report policy-specific estimates and uncertainty

interpretation_limits: no Gamma physical/team synergy or dual-control claim
no global policy value from a single-action intervention
integrity_failure_policy: block interpretation; no silent state/seed exclusion or physics rescue; computational retries only same seed/protocol with provenance
